data.notes: Only a small number of in-scope January 2027 contemporary music events are confirmed so far; classical Cartagena Festival de Música listings were excluded.

events.title: Buena Vida Beach 2027
events.summary: Three-day electronic beach festival at Punta Canoa, Cartagena, confirmed for January 8–10, 2027. The official site bills it as a major Caribbean electronic festival; the artist lineup is still marked as forthcoming.

events.title: Cartagena Music Week
events.summary: A multi-day 3 NOMADS X–listed music-week takeover in Cartagena, running January 3–11, likely the broadest confirmed underground/travel-party framework around the city’s peak electronic week.

events.title: Juicy & Cream at Atolón Beach Club
events.summary: 3 NOMADS X lists Juicy & Cream at Atolón Beach Club in Cartagena for January 9, marking a notable beach-club edition from its Colombian experiential party ecosystem.

events.title: Motion Fest – Rainbow Beach
events.summary: Passline lists this 18+ Caribbean festival celebrating music, freedom, diversity and love, with a two-day program that includes a Carrusel Boat party and a Main Party in Cartagena.

events.title: Nativo Cartagena
events.summary: 3 NOMADS X lists its Nativo Cartagena event on its 2027 experience calendar for January 2 in Cartagena, positioning it as part of the city’s early-January electronic/Latin travel-party circuit.
